journey: Launched the release app with an isolated data directory and port.
Waited for the frozen sidecar health endpoint to become available.
Terminated the desktop owner process to simulate an abnormal app exit.
The sidecar detected that its expected parent PID disappeared and stopped by the second 0.5-second check.
The sidecar process exited and port 18792 closed; no release app or sidecar process remained.
implementation_boundary: Tauri passes its process ID through DZMM_NEXT_PARENT_PID when spawning the sidecar.
The Python sidecar owns a small asynchronous parent watcher and asks Uvicorn to shut down when reparented.
Normal Tauri exit cleanup remains in place; this closes the force-exit gap without UI coupling.
not_proven: Windows parent-loss behavior still requires a native package process test.
This is a packaged process-lifecycle check, not the blocked macOS WebView A-F visual journey.
